definitions.gloss: prevention method; preventive measure; way to prevent
definitions.explanation: A method or approach for preventing disease, accidents, problems, or other undesirable outcomes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予防法|よぼうほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}りたい→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: I want to know how to prevent colds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{効果的|こうかてき}→効果的：04793_koukateki⟧な{予防法|よぼうほう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}→熱中症：08330_necchuushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予防法|よぼうほう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦こまめ→こまめ：10325_komame⟧な⟦{水分|すいぶん}{補給|ほきゅう}→水分補給：14832_suibunhokyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: As a way to prevent heatstroke, frequent hydration is important.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧ (prevention) and ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (method). Commonly used in health, medical, and safety contexts. Note that {予防法|よぼうほう} can also refer to specific prevention-related laws (e.g., {感染症|かんせんしょう}{予防法|よぼうほう} — the Infectious Disease Prevention Act), where ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ means "law" rather than "method."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予防法|よぼうほう}: cold prevention methods
- ⟦{効果的|こうかてき}→効果的：04793_koukateki⟧な{予防法|よぼうほう}: effective prevention method
- {予防法|よぼうほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実践|じっせん}→実践：08241_jissen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to practice a prevention method
- {予防法|よぼうほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}する→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧: to introduce prevention methods

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{予防|よぼう}{策|さく}→予防策：18498_yobousaku⟧: preventive measure — emphasizes it as a planned countermeasure
- ⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: preventive countermeasure — often used in organizational or governmental contexts
- ⟦{防止|ぼうし}{策|さく}→防止策：21966_boushisaku⟧: prevention measure — focuses on stopping something from occurring
